payload.exact_io_duplicate_audit: zero within/cross-split duplicates before policy freeze
payload.extinction: remaining proposal budget executes failed baseline placeholders; no archive-parent fallback, no eligible birth/winner
payload.fitness: one fixed output rank must reconstruct every complete demonstration after all demo adaptation; query answers excluded
payload.genotype_identity: validated shared base hash plus 9 functional alleles; full artifact hash separate lineage
payload.limitations: 4 proposals per arm, narrow synthetic curriculum; no independent efficacy/frontier claim
payload.mate_rule: same-hash draw replaced by lowest canonical-hash distinct contemporary when possible
payload.mortality: neutral contemporary genotype preserves age, including death boundary; no elite immortality
payload.mortality_sharing: same mechanics in crossover/mutation; no individual-mechanism efficacy isolation
payload.random_control: uniform two alleles from same bank; independent of parent fitness; same physical call budget
payload.report_cache: identical canonical winner may reuse report only, explicitly not independent replicates
payload.selection_cache: no candidate fitness cache; within-candidate demonstration-state reuse
payload.winner: eligible archive maximum absolute demo solve count, canonical genotype then artifact hash tie; archive never parent pool
